findings.evidence_type: decoded static instructions plus Microsoft API contract
findings.conclusion: The registration path constructs a recurring TimeTrigger with freshnessTime=60 minutes and oneShot=false.
observations: 0x1804a0da6 references the Windows.ApplicationModel.Background.TimeTrigger runtime-class string; wrapper forwards interval and boolean to the factory.
0x1804a0df9..0x1804a0e24 normalizes the Boolean and passes interval=60 plus false to the activation-factory call.
findings.limitation: This establishes the static scheduling request, not successful registration or an observed hourly execution cadence; Windows scheduling and conditions apply.

findings.evidence_type: decoded static instructions plus Microsoft enum contract
findings.conclusion: The task has both InternetAvailable (3) and FreeNetworkAvailable (7) conditions.
observations: 0x1804a09ab passes edx=3; 0x1804a09c8 passes edx=7 to constructor 0x1804a0c90.
Two constructed objects are stored in a length-2 array; 0x1804a0a39 passes the array to the task builder helper; 0x1804a0b60..0x1804a0b7c iterates it.
findings.limitation: The numeric constants and constructor chain are decoded. Runtime network classification and trigger history were not observed.

findings.evidence_type: decoded static instructions and packaged runtime-class strings
findings.conclusion: The same path supplies task name UpdateLiveTileTask and entry point Duracellko.BingImage.Universal.Service.UpdateLiveTileBackgroundTask to a BackgroundTaskBuilder helper.
observations: 0x1804a0a32 loads task-name string object 0x1802c3798; 0x1804a0a3f loads entry-point string object 0x1802c37d8; 0x1804a0a46 calls 0x1804a0ab0.
0x1804a0ad2 calls a lookup helper; if it returns non-null, 0x1804a0ada skips the builder path.
findings.limitation: The name/entry-point/trigger data flow is visible; individual generic WinRT dispatch thunks do not carry recovered source symbols.

findings.evidence_type: decoded static instructions; interface-dispatch semantics inferred
findings.conclusion: UpdateLiveTileMaintenanceTask is placed in a one-element list consumed before the recurring TimeTrigger registration. The path is consistent with legacy-task cleanup, not evidence of a second active maintenance trigger.
observations: 0x18034e0d5 creates a length-1 array; 0x18034e0ea loads UpdateLiveTileMaintenanceTask; array is stored at static 0x1802a8640.
0x1804a0fdd calls the same name-lookup helper; when non-null, 0x1804a0fe7 sets dl=1 and calls an interface method.
findings.limitation: Unregister(true) is an interpretation of the lookup/Boolean/interface-call shape. No MaintenanceTrigger constructor was established by this bounded analysis.

findings.evidence_type: decoded static instructions plus exact UTF-16 key strings
findings.conclusion: The application stores separate Boolean settings UseBingImageAsDesktopBackground and UseBingImageAsLockScreen through Windows.Storage.ApplicationData.
observations: Desktop writer 0x18051d430 and lock-screen writer 0x18051d650 take the incoming Boolean in dl, box it at object offset +8, then pass it with the respective key.
Desktop reader is 0x18051d510; lock-screen reader is 0x18051d730. Both retrieve by key, cast a non-null object to Boolean, and build a two-byte nullable value.
Both readers initialize that two-byte value to zero and leave it zero when the key lookup returns null.
findings.limitation: These are reconstructed roles from argument/data flow, not recovered source method names.

findings.evidence_type: decoded caller instructions plus inferred .NET Native shared-table mapping
findings.conclusion: Both automatic wallpaper settings have a strongly supported false fallback when the stored key is absent.
observations: Readers initialize a two-byte nullable value to 0, and call through slot 0x1802a2a20 with its address.
The source-file slot contains 0x800000000000411b. It is not a directly usable static function pointer.
The installed framework SharedLibrary.dll exports $NEAT$ as an RVA table. Its zero-based index 0x411b points to RVA 0x5687d0. REA decodes that candidate helper as movzx eax,byte [rcx+1]; ret.
The immediately previous NEAT entry checks the first byte and returns the second byte or throws, consistent with nullable get_Value; selected entry is consistent with GetValueOrDefault.
findings.limitation: The zero-based NEAT import binding is inferred from file format and matching helper semantics; the runtime binder was not traced. Therefore report as a strong static reconstruction, not proof that current user settings are off.

limitations: Read-only file analysis; no application execution, setting change, background registration, or wallpaper change was performed.
No deep pseudocode is claimed. Rizin machine instructions are decoded through the REA CLI.
Addresses are preferred-image VAs; they are not live-process addresses.
Only assigned background registration and settings paths were inspected; this is not a complete binary audit.
The two settings-read raw REA outputs extend past their PE exception-table range; assembly.txt deliberately limits each to its function range.
